name: Eclipse 2.1.9 - DPS and dungeon-run fixes
notes: Corrective update: live party DPS returns to 0 after 2 seconds without received damage; next hit starts a fresh DPS window. Run totals and summaries remain intact. Internal dungeon teleports preserve runs, supported final bosses close them, and missing-catalogue activities no longer permanently block DPS after a run. Existing UPDATE and standalone setup retained.
